blocks.text: To'g'ri ma'no tanish: **up** — yuqoriga, **down** — pastga: stand **up**, sit **down**, go **up**, go **down** (→ qizil kitob, 114-dars). Bu ma'no tabiiy ravishda kengayadi: **up** — **ko'proq, kuchliroq, tezroq** (turn up, speed up, put up prices), **down** — **kamroq, sekinroq, tinchroq** (turn down, slow down, calm down). **down** ning yana uch ma'nosi bor: **yerga qulatish** (knock down, burn down), **ishdan chiqish va rad etish** (break down, let down, turn down) va **qog'ozga tushirish** (write down). O'zbekchadagi «buzib **tashlamoq**», «buzilib **qolmoq**», «yozib **qo'ymoq**» shu ma'nolarga mos.

items.text: The landlord **put up** the rent, so Jasur had to find a cheaper flat.
items.translation: Uy egasi ijara haqini **oshirdi**, shuning uchun Jasur arzonroq kvartira topishga majbur bo'ldi.

items.text: **Turn** the radio **up** — they're talking about the flood in Fergana.
items.translation: Radioni **balandlat** — Farg'onadagi suv toshqini haqida gapirishyapti.

items.text: We **took down** the old pictures and painted the walls white.
items.translation: Eski suratlarni **yechib olib**, devorlarni oqqa bo'yadik.

blocks.text: put up va pick up: bitta fe'l — ko'p ma'no

Ikki eng serma'no fe'l. **put up**: biror narsani tik **o'rnatmoq** yoki **osmoq** (a tent, shelves, a notice); kimnidir **tunashga joylashtirmoq** (**put** sb **up** for the night); narxni **oshirmoq** (BrE: **put up** prices = raise prices); **put up a fight** — qarshilik ko'rsatmoq. **put up with** (chidamoq) esa uch qismli alohida fe'l (→ 143-dars). **pick up** ning ma'nolari kontekstga qarab o'zgaradi — jadvalga qarang.

items.text: My aunt **put** us **up** for a week when we first arrived in Manchester.
items.translation: Manchesterga ilk bor kelganimizda xolam bizni bir hafta **o'zinikida yashatdi**.

items.text: Dilnoza **picked up** a few words of Italian while working in Rome.
items.translation: Dilnoza Rimda ishlab yurib, italyan tilidan bir nechta so'z **o'rganib oldi**.

items.text: After a quiet winter, bookings at the hotel **picked up** again.
items.translation: Sokin qishdan keyin mehmonxonadagi bronlar yana **ko'paydi**.

blocks.text: down = yerga qulatish: knock down, burn down, cut down

Bu guruhda **down** biror narsa **yerga qulab, butunlay vayron bo'lishini** bildiradi. **knock down** / **pull down** / **tear down** — binoni buzib tashlamoq; **knock** sb **down** — (mashina) odamni urib yiqitmoq, ko'pincha majhulda: He was **knocked down** by a bus. **burn down** — yonib kul bo'lmoq (to'ldiruvchisiz) yoki yoqib yubormoq (to'ldiruvchili). **cut down** — daraxtni kesib tashlamoq; **blow down** — shamol qulatmoq. O'zbekchada: buzib **tashlamoq**, urib **yiqitmoq**, kesib **tashlamoq**.

items.text: The old factory was **pulled down**, and a park was created in its place.
items.translation: Eski zavod **buzib tashlandi**, uning o'rnida bog' barpo etildi.

items.text: Be careful crossing here — a boy was **knocked down** by a car last month.
items.translation: Bu yerdan o'tayotganda ehtiyot bo'ling — o'tgan oy bir bolani mashina **urib yiqitgan**.

blocks.text: **down** — darajaning pasayishi: **slow down**, **calm down** (tinchlanmoq / tinchlantirmoq), **cut down** (on) — kamaytirmoq (cut down **on** sugar; cut **down** a text — qisqartirmoq), **keep down** — (shovqin, xarajat, narx) past ushlab turmoq, **die down** — (shamol, olqish, mish-mish) so'nmoq, **settle down** — o'rnashib qolmoq, oila qurib tinchimoq. Faoliyat to'xtashi yoki **muvaffaqiyatsizlik**: **break down** — (mashina) buzilmoq, (muzokara) barbod bo'lmoq, (odam) o'zini tutolmay yig'lab yubormoq; **close down** — (do'kon, zavod) butunlay yopilmoq; **let down** — umidini puchga chiqarmoq; **turn down** — rad etmoq; **back down** — bahsda yon bermoq; **step down** — lavozimdan ketmoq.

items.text: Our talks with the supplier **broke down** over the price.
items.translation: Yetkazib beruvchi bilan muzokaralarimiz narx masalasida **barbod bo'ldi**.

items.text: Sarah felt **let down** when her best friend forgot her birthday.
items.translation: Eng yaqin dugonasi tug'ilgan kunini unutganda Saraning **ko'ngli qoldi**.

items.text: The wind finally **died down**, and the ferry was able to leave.
items.translation: Shamol nihoyat **tindi** va parom jo'nab keta oldi.

blocks.text: **down** — qog'ozga tushirish: **write down** (yozib olmoq), **note down** / **jot down** (tezda qayd etib qo'ymoq), **take down** (birov aytganini yozib olmoq), **put** sb **down for** (ro'yxatga yozib qo'ymoq). Ehtiyot bo'ling: **put** sb **down** — kimnidir kamsitmoq, boshqalar oldida yerga urmoq.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He disappointed me» — to'g'ri, lekin so'zlashuvda ko'proq He **let me down**; «They refused my offer» o'rniga tabiiyroq — They **turned down** my offer (lekin «refuse to do» — turn down to do emas); «Make the music lower» → **Turn** the music **down**; «The prices put up» → The prices **went up** (o'zi oshsa — go up, kimdir oshirsa — put up); «cut down sugar» → **cut down on** sugar (kamaytirish ma'nosida — on), **cut down** a tree — kesmoq; «My car is broken down» emas — My car **has broken down** yoki My car **broke down**; «Calm down yourself» → **Calm down**!

**up** / **down** juftliklarini «ovoz tugmasi» deb tasavvur qiling: up — kuchaytiradi (turn up, speed up, put up prices, cheer up), down — pasaytiradi (turn down, slow down, bring down, calm down). **down** ning «qulatish» va «qog'ozga tushirish» ma'nolari esa pastga harakatdan kelib chiqadi: bino yerga tushadi, so'z qog'ozga tushadi.
Bog'lanish: up ning boshqa ma'nolari — 143–144-darslar (grow up, end up, use up, tidy up); put up with — 143-dars; pick up / drop off — 141-dars; frazali fe'l turlari va olmosh o'rni — 137-dars.

examples.title: Up and down: **put up**, **take down**, **pick up**
examples.description: **put up** — o'rnatmoq, osmoq (javon, plakat, chodir); **put** sb **up** — tunashga joy bermoq; **take down** — yechib olmoq; **pick up** — qo'lga olmoq; **put down** — qo'ymoq; **bend down** — engashmoq.

sentences.text: We **put up** the tent quickly because it was starting to rain.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir boshlanayotgani uchun chodirni tezda **tikdik**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **put up** some shelves in the kitchen last weekend.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'tgan dam olish kunlari oshxonaga bir nechta javon **o'rnatdi**.

sentences.text: The students **put up** posters about the concert all over the university.
sentences.translation: Talabalar universitet bo'ylab konsert haqidagi plakatlarni **osib chiqishdi**.

sentences.text: After the holidays, we **took down** the decorations and put them in the attic.
sentences.translation: Bayramdan keyin bezaklarni **yechib olib**, chordoqqa qo'ydik.

sentences.text: Can you help me **take** these curtains **down**? I want to wash them.
sentences.translation: Bu pardalarni **yechib olishga** yordam berasanmi? Ularni yuvmoqchiman.

sentences.text: Nilufar **bent down** to tie her shoelace and dropped her phone.
sentences.translation: Nilufar bog'ichini bog'lash uchun **engashdi** va telefonini tushirib yubordi.

sentences.text: The baby started crying, so Madina **picked** her **up** and sang to her.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq yig'lay boshladi, Madina uni **qo'liga olib**, alla aytdi.

sentences.text: **Put** that vase **down** carefully — it belonged to my great-grandmother.
sentences.translation: Bu guldonni ehtiyotlab **qo'y** — u katta buvimga tegishli edi.

sentences.text: Could you **put** me **up** for a couple of nights when I come to London?
sentences.translation: Londonga kelganimda meni ikki kecha **o'zingnikida qoldira olasanmi**?

sentences.text: When the teacher came in, the students **put down** their phones and **picked up** their pens.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi kirganda, talabalar telefonlarini **qo'yib**, ruchkalarini **qo'llariga olishdi**.

examples.title: More or less: **turn up**, **turn down**, **come down**
examples.description: **up** — ko'proq, **down** — kamroq: **turn up** / **turn down** — balandlatmoq / pasaytirmoq; **put up** / **bring down** — (narxni) oshirmoq / tushirmoq; **go up** / **come down** — oshmoq / tushmoq; **speed up** / **slow down**; **warm up** / **cool down**.

sentences.text: Could you **turn** the volume **up**? I can't hear what the reporter is saying.
sentences.translation: Ovozni **balandlatib** qo'yasizmi? Muxbir nima deyayotganini eshitmayapman.

sentences.text: It's boiling in here — let's **turn** the heating **down** a bit.
sentences.translation: Bu yer qaynab ketyapti — isitishni biroz **pasaytiraylik**.

sentences.text: The landlord has **put up** the rent again, so we're thinking of moving.
sentences.translation: Uy egasi ijara haqini yana **oshirdi**, shuning uchun ko'chishni o'ylayapmiz.

sentences.text: Petrol prices **came down** slightly in the spring, but they're rising again now.
sentences.translation: Bahorda benzin narxi biroz **tushdi**, lekin hozir yana ko'tarilyapti.

sentences.text: The government wants to **bring down** inflation before the elections.
sentences.translation: Hukumat saylovgacha inflyatsiyani **tushirmoqchi**.

sentences.text: The new software has **speeded up** the whole process.
sentences.translation: Yangi dastur butun jarayonni **tezlashtirdi**.

sentences.text: **Slow down** — you're going to miss the turning to Samarkand!
sentences.translation: **Sekinlang** — Samarqandga burilishdan o'tib ketasiz!

sentences.text: Always **warm up** for ten minutes before you go running.
sentences.translation: Yugurishdan oldin doim o'n daqiqa **badanni qizdirib oling**.

sentences.text: After the match, the players **cooled down** with some gentle stretching.
sentences.translation: O'yindan keyin futbolchilar yengil cho'zilish mashqlari bilan **badanni sovutishdi**.

sentences.text: Will house prices **go up** or **come down** next year? — Nobody really knows.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yili uy narxlari **oshadimi** yoki **tushadimi**? — Buni hech kim aniq bilmaydi.

examples.title: The many meanings of **pick up**
examples.description: **pick up**: qo'lga olmoq; (mashinada) olib ketmoq; yo'l-yo'lakay sotib olmoq; (til, odat) o'rganib olmoq; (savdo, shamol) kuchaymoq; (kasallik) yuqtirmoq; (signal) tutmoq; **pick up where you left off** — to'xtagan joydan davom etmoq.

sentences.text: Could you **pick up** a few lemons and some milk on your way back from the gym?
sentences.translation: Sport zalidan qaytayotib bir nechta limon va sut **olib kela olasanmi**?

sentences.text: Aziz will **pick** us **up** at the station at half past six.
sentences.translation: Aziz bizni soat oltiyarimda vokzaldan **olib ketadi**.

sentences.text: Children **pick up** languages much faster than adults do.
sentences.translation: Bolalar tillarni kattalarga qaraganda ancha tez **o'zlashtirib oladi**.

sentences.text: Where did you **pick up** that terrible habit of biting your nails?
sentences.translation: Tirnoq tishlash degan yomon odatni qayerdan **yuqtirib olding**?

sentences.text: Business was slow in January, but it **picked up** in the spring.
sentences.translation: Yanvarda savdo sust edi, lekin bahorda **jonlandi**.

sentences.text: I think I **picked up** a cold on the plane — everyone was coughing.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, samolyotda shamollashni **yuqtirib oldim** — hamma yo'talayotgan edi.

sentences.text: Our radio can't **pick up** any stations in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Tog'larda radiomiz birorta ham stansiyani **tutmaydi**.

sentences.text: The wind **picked up** in the afternoon, so we couldn't go sailing.
sentences.translation: Tushdan keyin shamol **kuchaydi**, shuning uchun yelkanli qayiqda suza olmadik.

sentences.text: Let's **pick up** where we left off yesterday — page forty, I think.
sentences.translation: Kecha to'xtagan joyimizdan **davom etaylik** — qirqinchi sahifa edi, shekilli.

sentences.text: Nobody **picked up** the phone, so Kate left a message.
sentences.translation: Hech kim telefonni **ko'tarmadi**, shuning uchun Keyt xabar qoldirdi.

examples.title: Destroyed: **knock down**, **burn down**, **cut down**
examples.description: **down** — yerga qulatish: **knock down** / **pull down** / **tear down** — (binoni) buzib tashlamoq; (mashina odamni) urib yiqitmoq; **burn down** — yonib kul bo'lmoq; **cut down** — (daraxtni) kesib tashlamoq; **blow down** — (shamol) qulatmoq.

sentences.text: The council plans to **knock down** the old bus station and build flats there.
sentences.translation: Shahar kengashi eski avtobus bekatini **buzib tashlab**, o'rniga uylar qurishni rejalashtirmoqda.

sentences.text: A cyclist was **knocked down** by a van outside our school this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab maktabimiz oldida velosipedchini furgon **urib yiqitdi**.

sentences.text: Hundreds of trees were **cut down** to make room for the new motorway.
sentences.translation: Yangi avtomagistralga joy ochish uchun yuzlab daraxt **kesib tashlandi**.

sentences.text: The farmhouse **burned down** while the family was at a wedding in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Oila Farg'onada to'yda bo'lganida ferma uyi **yonib kul bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Last night's storm **blew down** several trees on our street.
sentences.translation: Kechagi bo'ron ko'chamizdagi bir nechta daraxtni **qulatib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Local people protested when the developers wanted to **pull down** the historic market.
sentences.translation: Quruvchilar tarixiy bozorni **buzib tashlamoqchi** bo'lganda, mahalliy aholi norozilik bildirdi.

sentences.text: Who would want to **burn down** a school? The police are still investigating.
sentences.translation: Kim maktabni **yoqib yubormoqchi** bo'lishi mumkin? Politsiya hali ham tergov olib bormoqda.

sentences.text: If you **cut down** that tree, the garden will get much more sun.
sentences.translation: Agar u daraxtni **kesib tashlasang**, bog'ga ancha ko'p quyosh tushadi.

sentences.text: The old wall was so weak that the children **knocked** it **down** with a football.
sentences.translation: Eski devor shunchalik nimjon ediki, bolalar uni futbol to'pi bilan **qulatib yuborishdi**.

sentences.text: In the 1960s many beautiful old houses in Tashkent were **torn down**.
sentences.translation: 1960-yillarda Toshkentdagi ko'plab chiroyli eski uylar **buzib tashlangan**.

examples.title: Calmer: **calm down**, **cut down on**, **die down**
examples.description: **down** — kamaytirish, tinchlantirish: **calm down** — tinchlanmoq / tinchlantirmoq; **cut down (on)** — kamaytirmoq; **cut down** a text — qisqartirmoq; **keep down** — past ushlab turmoq; **die down** — so'nmoq; **settle down** — o'rnashib qolmoq.

sentences.text: Take a deep breath and **calm down** — losing your temper won't solve anything.
sentences.translation: Chuqur nafas olib, **tinchlan** — jahl bilan hech narsa hal bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: It took the nurse ten minutes to **calm** the frightened child **down**.
sentences.translation: Hamshiraga qo'rqib ketgan bolani **tinchlantirish** uchun o'n daqiqa kerak bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Aziz is trying to **cut down on** coffee because it keeps him awake at night.
sentences.translation: Aziz qahvani **kamaytirishga** harakat qilyapti, chunki u kechasi uxlatmaydi.

sentences.text: I've **cut down** from twenty cigarettes a day to five.
sentences.translation: Kuniga yigirmata sigaretdan beshtagacha **kamaytirdim**.

sentences.text: Please **keep** the noise **down** — the baby has just fallen asleep.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **ovozingizni pasaytiring** — chaqaloq endigina uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: We need to **keep** costs **down** if we want to survive this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yildan omon chiqmoqchi bo'lsak, xarajatlarni **past ushlab turishimiz** kerak.

sentences.text: We waited in the car until the storm **died down**.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron **tinchiguncha** mashinada kutib turdik.

sentences.text: The applause didn't **die down** for almost five minutes.
sentences.translation: Olqishlar deyarli besh daqiqa **tinmadi**.

sentences.text: After years of travelling, Oliver finally **settled down** in a small village near Oxford.
sentences.translation: Yillar davomida sayohat qilgach, Oliver nihoyat Oksford yaqinidagi kichik qishloqda **o'rnashib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Your essay is too long — you'll have to **cut** it **down** to two thousand words.
sentences.translation: Inshoingiz juda uzun — uni ikki ming so'zgacha **qisqartirishingiz** kerak bo'ladi.

examples.title: Failing: **break down**, **let down**, **turn down**
examples.description: **break down** — (mashina) buzilmoq; (muzokara) barbod bo'lmoq; (odam) o'zini tutolmay yig'lab yubormoq; **close down** — butunlay yopilmoq; **let down** — pand bermoq; **turn down** — rad etmoq; **back down** — yon bermoq; **step down** — lavozimdan ketmoq.

sentences.text: The lift **broke down** again, and we had to carry the sofa up eight floors.
sentences.translation: Lift yana **buzilib qoldi**, divanni sakkiz qavatga ko'tarib chiqishga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: When she heard the news, Madina **broke down** and cried for an hour.
sentences.translation: Xabarni eshitib, Madina **o'zini tutolmadi** va bir soat yig'ladi.

sentences.text: After forty years, the little bookshop on our street **closed down**.
sentences.translation: Qirq yildan keyin ko'chamizdagi kichkina kitob do'koni **butunlay yopildi**.

sentences.text: Tom promised to help me move, but he **let** me **down** at the last minute.
sentences.translation: Tom ko'chishimga yordam berishga va'da bergandi, lekin so'nggi daqiqada **pand berdi**.

sentences.text: The fans felt **let down** when the team lost the final again.
sentences.translation: Jamoa finalda yana yutqazganda muxlislarning **ko'ngli qoldi**.

sentences.text: Kate was offered a place at Oxford, but she **turned** it **down** to stay near her family.
sentences.translation: Keytga Oksforddan o'rin taklif qilishdi, lekin u oilasiga yaqin qolish uchun **rad etdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod asked Nilufar to marry him, and she didn't **turn** him **down**!
sentences.translation: Bekzod Nilufarga turmush qurishni taklif qildi va u **rad etmadi**!

sentences.text: Neither side was willing to **back down**, so the argument went on all evening.
sentences.translation: Ikki tomondan hech biri **yon bermadi**, shuning uchun bahs butun oqshom davom etdi.

sentences.text: The director **stepped down** after the scandal became public.
sentences.translation: Janjal oshkor bo'lgach, direktor **lavozimidan ketdi**.

sentences.text: Don't **let** your team **down** — they're counting on you.
sentences.translation: Jamoangning **umidini puchga chiqarma** — ular senga ishonib turishibdi.

examples.title: On paper: **write down**, **note down**, **put down**
examples.description: **down** — qog'ozga tushirish: **write down** / **note down** / **jot down** — yozib olmoq, qayd etmoq; **take down** — birov aytganini yozib olmoq; **put** sb **down for** — ro'yxatga yozib qo'ymoq; **put** sb **down** — kamsitmoq.

sentences.text: **Jot down** your ideas as soon as they come to you, or you'll forget them.
sentences.translation: Fikrlaringiz kelishi bilan ularni **yozib qo'ying**, aks holda unutasiz.

sentences.text: The police officer **took down** our names and addresses.
sentences.translation: Politsiyachi ismlarimiz va manzillarimizni **yozib oldi**.

sentences.text: Did you **write down** the number of the car that hit you?
sentences.translation: Sizni urib ketgan mashinaning raqamini **yozib oldingizmi**?

sentences.text: During the lecture, Emma **noted down** every date the professor mentioned.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza paytida Emma professor tilga olgan har bir sanani **qayd etib bordi**.

sentences.text: Shall I **put** you **down for** the trip to Khiva? There are only three places left.
sentences.translation: Sizni Xiva safariga **yozib qo'yaymi**? Faqat uchta joy qoldi.

sentences.text: Hang on — let me get a pen and **write** the address **down**.
sentences.translation: Shoshma — ruchka olib, manzilni **yozib olay**.

sentences.text: My old boss used to **put** people **down** in front of the whole team.
sentences.translation: Eski boshlig'im odamlarni butun jamoa oldida **kamsitardi**.

sentences.text: Never **put** yourself **down** — you're much more talented than you think.
sentences.translation: Hech qachon **o'zingni kamsitma** — sen o'ylaganingdan ancha iqtidorlisan.

sentences.text: **Write down** what you spend each day, and you'll see where your money goes.
sentences.translation: Har kuni nimaga pul sarflaganingizni **yozib boring**, shunda pulingiz qayerga ketayotganini ko'rasiz.

sentences.text: The receptionist **wrote down** my details and told me to wait.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimi ma'lumotlarimni **yozib oldi** va kutib turishimni aytdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a noisy neighbour
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: qo'shnisidan shikoyat qilgan ayol va uzr so'ragan yigit — turn down, put up with, put up, keep down, write down, break down, pick up, calm down, let down.

sentences.text: — Excuse me, could you **turn** the music **down**? It's after midnight.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, musiqani **pasaytira olasizmi**? Yarim tundan o'tdi.

sentences.text: — Sorry! I didn't know the walls were so thin. I'll **turn** it **down** now.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz! Devorlar bunchalik yupqa ekanini bilmagan ekanman. Hozir **pasaytiraman**.

sentences.text: — Thanks. It's the third time this week — I can't **put up with** it any more.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Bu hafta uchinchi marta — bunga endi **chiday olmayman**.

sentences.text: — I understand. My brother is staying with us, and he's **put up** speakers in every room!
sentences.translation: — Tushunaman. Akam biznikida turibdi, u har bir xonaga karnay **o'rnatib chiqqan**!

sentences.text: — Well, please ask him to **keep** the noise **down** after ten.
sentences.translation: — Unday bo'lsa, undan soat o'ndan keyin **shovqinni pasaytirishni** so'rang.

sentences.text: — Of course. Shall I **write down** my number in case it happens again?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Yana takrorlansa, deb raqamimni **yozib beraymi**?

sentences.text: — That would help. Sorry if I sounded angry — my car **broke down** today.
sentences.translation: — Yordam berardi. Jahl bilan gapirgan bo'lsam, uzr — bugun mashinam **buzilib qoldi**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! If you need a lift tomorrow, I can **pick** you **up** on my way to work.
sentences.translation: — Voy! Ertaga kerak bo'lsa, ishga ketayotib sizni **olib ketishim** mumkin.

sentences.text: — That's really kind. You've completely **calmed** me **down**.
sentences.translation: — Juda mehribonsiz. Meni butunlay **tinchlantirdingiz**.

sentences.text: — No problem. I promise we won't **let** you **down** again — goodnight!
sentences.translation: — Hechqisi yo'q. Va'da beraman, endi sizni **ranjitmaymiz** — xayrli tun!
